articles.title: Fapon Showcases High-Performance IVD Raw Materials at JACLaS EXPO 2026
articles.description: **media[1247308]**KOBE, Japan, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fapon, a trusted global IVD provider, will showcase its one-stop IVD solution at JACLaS EXPO 2026, held October 8-10 in Kobe, Japan. Visit Booth B32, Hall 1, 1st Floor. Fapon will spotlight its latest breakthroughs in small molecule sandwich antibodies and mouse-free IgG blockers. The small molecule sandwich antibody panel covers Vitamin D (25-OH VD), Estradiol (E2), and Thyroxine (fT4/T4), delivering high sensitivity and strong clinical correlation against gold-standard mass spectrometry. On the CLIA platform, the assay achieves LoD of 1.0 ng/mL for 25-OH VD, 1.0 pg/mL for E2, and LoB as low as 0.000989 ng/dL for free T4, with 25-OH VD and E2 antibodies showing R² of 0.96 and 0.99 against LC-MS/MS respectively.
